comment: The app this Craft port builds. scripts/craft.py runs the shared Craft tools pinned in scripts/tooling.json; they read only this file for app-specific names.
name: PdfCraft

craft_fonts.comment: The fallback faces for other scripts that PdfCraft embeds from craft-fonts (Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Georgian, Devanagari, symbols; about 3 MB). The Japanese, Korean and Chinese faces (about 42 MB) are left out of the AROS programs, which AROS loads into memory whole; the optional Simplified Chinese manifest is not part of the set.
